items.title: A filtered colimit of constructible sheaves with constructible colimit is essentially constant
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a filtered colimit of constructible sheaves whose colimit is constructible is essentially constant, in the three settings of sheaves of sets, abelian sheaves and modules over a Noetherian ring (statement lines 11902-11919). The proof is a complete argument repeated in the three settings: the loci where the maps on stalks fail to be surjective, respectively fail to induce the same images, are constructible by the support result and are pointwise eventually empty because the stalks of a constructible sheaf are finite, so quasi-compactness of the constructible topology makes them empty for large index (proof lines 11922-11953); the abelian case reduces to the case of sets (proof lines 11956-11957); and the module case runs the same argument with cokernels and kernels inside the abelian category of constructible modules (proof lines 11960-11987). The non-formal content is the measurement of the failure of surjectivity and injectivity by constructible loci. The claim is H2: a written argument carried through three settings.
